question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which one of Sam's sports teams would you join?
Should Sam and Colt get back together?

nodes.text: Sam strides angrily off the field. On the way out, she sees the mascot head of Lyle the Lizard on a bench and kicks it, sending it flying!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Lyle! Is he going to be okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look away, Amanda.
Hector holds Amanda close, as the Lyle head flies into the goalpost and lands hard on the ground, dented!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're going to pay for that!
Sam leaves the field.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I quit. I'm tired of doing the team laundry, shining your shoes, and looking after Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I... No one quits cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just did.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You haven't kicked me off so far, even when I ran off with your date.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It fits that he ran off with some other girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All the same, you could've gotten rid of me then, but you didn't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Only because it was fun holding cheerleading above your head, but since you obviously don't care about your pride as a cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I really `am` kicking you off!
nodes.text_bbcode: I really [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] kicking you off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, you can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: New girl, you're on thin ice. You want to get cut too? Be my guest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Taylor, don't get your ponytail in a twist. I'm leaving.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know, Taylor. Sam actually makes some good points. Why can't we switch up where we stand?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't you start, Jessica. Look what you've done, Sam! You're upsetting my carefully cultivated position of power!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you admit you're just a power-hungry, attention hog?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How dare you even slightly call me a pig!
Taylor lunges at Sam and grabs her arm. Sam tries to shove Taylor away!
The two girls struggle until $ZOE pries them apart!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! Hey! Cut that out! We're not supposed to be fighting on school grounds!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And people are starting to `stare...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And people are starting to [color=#3b78e2][i]stare...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't listen to her, girls! Keep fighting! Girl fight! Girl fight!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I am not fighting in front of Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. Gross.
$ZOE pushes the girls apart. Taylor fixes her hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor, you are such a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, is that all you have to say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Yeah, I... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was a really pathetic show. I'm sure `everyone` is `so` glad to hear you give us a piece of your mind.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was a really pathetic show. I'm sure [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glad to hear you give us a piece of your mind.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you ask me, I wish she'd given us a little less.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, I agree.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said some really hurtful things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, you guys, I didn't mean to hurt you. Taylor, definitely, but not you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor, you are such a...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Enough of that. I'm cutting you off right there. You're way out of line this time, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what are you going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've been a pain in my side ever since you took Colt `and` the Queen of Hearts dance from me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've been a pain in my side ever since you took Colt [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] the Queen of Hearts dance from me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think you know what's coming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to kick me off the squad? Well, there's one last thing I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The kind that grants kids' wishes?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor, I didn't know you were so nice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Amanda, not that kind of witch. The kind that steals kids away and bakes them into pies!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor can bake?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, even Amanda's outsmarted you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're a bully. Maybe you don't operate the same way as $Travis and Ryan, but that's what you do to make us listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whether you threaten us with team chores or where we're going to be placed, you're the worst bully there is.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You are a... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't hold back on `my` account. Or you were too slow to think of good insult?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stick to the bottom, Sam. It gets a little vicious up top if you poke your head out too far.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you know what you are? You're a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your routine sucked!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, `I'm` the one that made the routine last week!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one that made the routine last week!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Want to tell me exactly what was wrong with it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Sorry, Maria. I'm sure it wasn't your fault that everyone in the front row messed up their steps...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I was also in the front row!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Me too! And let me tell you, we worked really hard on that routine. You're the one that's `messed up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too! And let me tell you, we worked really hard on that routine. You're the one that's [color=#3b78e2][i]messed up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, forget what I said about the routine... Taylor, you think you're all that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It was not! Tell them, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, you did tell me to put you in the middle because we make you look better...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey! Is that why Taylor was the center of the show when Maria has the best front handspring of any of us?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... No! I just happen to look better because I have more experience?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, Taylor, you think you're all that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... The routine was... Bad?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, I `made` that routine!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And it was really good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, forget what I said about the routine... Taylor, you think you're all that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not only that, Taylor, but what about the routine that you made us do last week? It...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everything about this cheerleading team has to be about you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Newsflash. Not everyone can be at the top. I was once at the bottom and had to work my way up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that I have, I'm the `captain.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that I have, I'm the [color=#3b78e2][i]captain.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't mean you're a `star.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That doesn't mean you're a [color=#3b78e2][i]star.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sam's kind of right...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have `bad` taste. What's with these cheer uniforms?
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color] taste. What's with these cheer uniforms?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `These` cheer uniforms? You mean the ones that Keith picked out?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]These[/i][/color] cheer uniforms? You mean the ones that Keith picked out?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, just what's wrong with outfitting you girls in tight, one-piece suits?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `I` wasn't complaining.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] wasn't complaining.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All the better to see you with, my dear?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? These suits only look good on half of us.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Only half?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe Taylor let you get away with it, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... You're so lame!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow. Real `zinger` there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... And so are our cheer uniforms, am I right? I mean, one-piece polyester?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, I picked those uniforms out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget it. I don't need you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine!
Sam walks away and runs into $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were listening to us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but I didn't want you to walk to practice alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. Geez, this entire Colt thing is a huge weight on me. I can't stop thinking about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's going to take some time. Come on, let's go put some of that anger into cheerleading.
At practice, the cheerleaders run through their routine...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And twirl, and jump, and cartwheel! Dance step one, and two, and three, get into position, and... Lift, girls!
The center cheerleaders hold a complicated formation as Jessica and Sam are tossed into the air on either side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And drop it!
The cheerleaders dismount and stand in a straight line.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice work, girls... Except for some of you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica! Better cut down on those breadsticks from the pizza parlor. $ZOE should be able to fling you, not roll you in the air.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Jill, don't delude yourself into thinking you're a cheerleader. As mascot, you're the backstage show. I shouldn't see those cartwheels until midway through the jumps.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And finally, Sam... I don't know where to start. Maybe it's your pathetic cartwheels, your belly-flop of a flip, or your duck feet...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm just not seeing that cheerful cheerleader spark.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So your boyfriend dumped you. That doesn't mean we have to see it on your face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, that's `it.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, that's [color=#3b78e2][i]it.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam throws her pom-poms on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm tired of having to please you all the time, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never never never never `never!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Never never never never [color=#3b78e2][i]never![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, that was mature. I've heard Maddie say better.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're always so stubborn! You don't listen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're the one that's stubborn. When are you going to get it in your head that we're through?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I get what you're saying. And I'm saying I don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I've said I'm 'sorry' over and over. What else can I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing. I won't forgive you because I don't think I ever can!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Still not letting that one go? Yeah, I kissed Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it was an in-the-moment thing, an accident. I didn't mean for it to happen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but it did. Maybe you'll never do it again, Colt, but I don't think I can get over it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not if every time we make out, I think about you kissing Denni!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know what would make that better? Not thinking about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if we can survive this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think we can.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if you noticed, Colt, but I am also part of this relationship, and I'm saying that `we can't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if you noticed, Colt, but I am also part of this relationship, and I'm saying that [color=#3b78e2][i]we can't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe if you just try `harder` at making us work.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if you just try [color=#e23b3b][i]harder[/i][/color] at making us work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We are not an `us` anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: We are not an [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] anymore.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that how it's going to be?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Breaking up with Colt has changed you. And like I said before, I'm worried.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's nothing, $ZOE. It's my thing. I'm mad. I'll get over it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Speaking of... What do you want?
Sam points past $ZOE at Colt who has come up to them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you've said enough, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa there, Pepper Spray. I just want a word.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, we have cheerleading practice to go to.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just for a sec?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it's fine. Go ahead, $ZOE. I'll see you at practice.
Dubious, $ZOE walks away, and Colt and Sam walk to the more secluded school courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't call me that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, lighten up! I'm here to say 'sorry'. After our chem final, I got to thinking...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A big leap for you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Har har.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I got to thinking that we really are good for each other. I have fun with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Apparently I'm not the only one you have fun with...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, come on. Forget about it, and remember 'us' and who we are.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Colt and Sam. Dashing, charming troublemaker, and his hot girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hah! Is that all I am to you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. You're also a cheerleader. And one of the coolest girls I know.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you say, Sammy? Get back together and try again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't say that! Ashley, I'm sorry. Sam doesn't really know you...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, it's okay... I think she's right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do? But I'm sure you're not really a loser.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, but if I'm going to keep my boyfriend, I need to stop thinking like one!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm worried about him cheating on me or going behind my back, but maybe I just need to relax and hope things will work out.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: At the very least, it won't be a self-fulfilling prophecy. Thank you for being so honest. It helped.
Ashley leaves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You practically told that girl off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I helped her, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: He.. He is?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's why he's so distant, isn't it? Face the facts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe he's texting you less, maybe when he's talking to you a little less, and when you look at him, he doesn't make eye contact.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you think it's a great thing he's planning for you, but instead...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Surprise:` He's made out with some other girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Surprise:[/i][/color] He's made out with some other girl.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What... What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get out of the relationship before you regret it.
Ashley bursts into tears and runs off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! I can't believe you'd say something like that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `someone` had to say it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] had to say it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I think someone overheard you two yelling about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great...
At that moment, Ashley walks up and taps Sam on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Um... Sam? You don't really know me, but I heard you were a matchmaker, and you give out love advice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, but that shop's closed. Maybe you haven't heard out there in your nerd-verse, but I just broke up with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you should help her out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. What's `your` problem?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, fine. What's [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] problem?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: My boyfriend Andrew has been really distant lately. I'm not sure what's going on, and I don't know how to talk to him about it. What do you think the issue is?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Is something wrong with our relationship? Or is it me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How many times are you going to make me say it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you. You're not going to tell me that you broke up with Colt? `And` that it doesn't bother you at all?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you. You're not going to tell me that you broke up with Colt? [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] that it doesn't bother you at all?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought we were friends. I thought you could tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We are friends!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And who told you that Colt and I broke up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry to say this, but it's all over the school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great, that idiot told everyone, didn't he?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't want to tell you because I didn't want you to gloat or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't do that! Oh, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Why are you making that sad face?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I `am` sad. I'm so sorry to hear that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] sad. I'm so sorry to hear that!

nodes.text: $ZOE hugs Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You must feel awful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And, um, I have to tell you... I kind of already knew you and Colt broke up. It's all over the school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. I just feel `so` much better that everyone else knows about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great. I just feel [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much better that everyone else knows about it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did Colt tell them?

nodes.title: Anger Management
nodes.subtitle: Help Sam get control of her temper!

nodes.text: After school one day, Sam and $ZOE start walking to their lockers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm worried about you and how you've been acting these last few days. You haven't talked to anyone ever since your chemistry lab last week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I haven't seen you at home since Taylor kicked you out of practice last time. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm `fine.` What's there to be worried about?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color] What's there to be worried about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've been pretty angry lately with everyone lately...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah? When?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Sam, can you describe the central themes in our novel this week?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who cares about this stuff when there are more important things to learn? Like how much boys suck!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I'm surprised at you! That language is unacceptable. Go see Principal Shapiro...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...And then I told him that real donut holes are made of air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not this story again. Mom, you've told it a million times, and I'm sick of hearing it! It's boring, and I hate it!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're acting like a five-year old. Be polite. $ZOE hasn't heard it, and it's a funny story.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you just run off with $ZOE and have your perfect little family and go tell stories that I've already heard without me!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't use that tone with me, young lady. I think you need to go straight to your room.. .

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And, `you!` I can't stand you at all! You're always begging at my table for food...
nodes.text_bbcode: And, [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color] I can't stand you at all! You're always begging at my table for food...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Making noises when I'm trying to sleep...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And giving me the evil eye! I don't trust you `or` that furry face of yours one bit!
nodes.text_bbcode: And giving me the evil eye! I don't trust you [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] that furry face of yours one bit!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And you yelled at him until he hid under my bed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was just in a bad mood.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For seven days in a row?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever, $ZOE. It's in the past. It's all behind us.
The two girls round the corner... When someone runs into Sam!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoa! I'm sorry, cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch it, nerd, or the next time I see you, you'll wish your pocket protector protected `more than your pocket.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Watch it, nerd, or the next time I see you, you'll wish your pocket protector protected [color=#3b78e2][i]more than your pocket.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eep!
Erik runs off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did it again. You yelled at that poor kid. What's going on with you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been avoiding telling $ZOE that Colt and I broke up. I don't want her to rub it in... She never liked Colt that much.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it! Just try to keep your thoughts off everything except for the target.
Sam lets the arrow fly.
It whizzes through the air and embeds itself in the center of the target!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A perfect hit!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think about anyone or anything else. I just let the arrow fly.
Sam runs through the entire quiver of arrows.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, you got them all clustered in the center. It looks like you're really good at this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It definitely kept me from thinking too much about Colt.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like we found your sport. You should totally sign up for the team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! I'll do that right away!
The following Monday...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but our archery team was recently disbanded due to a terrible accident...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, did someone get hurt?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Just the front window of my only car! It's bad luck that Dex's arrow would've struck my windshield at that angle...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: But I guess it's good luck that it didn't hit me while I was inside!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: So the team's been disbanded. Might I suggest a different sport?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Principal.
At home...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry to hear it's not actually a sport. I could've sworn I heard the nerds talking about it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can find something else, I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's just really frustrating that I finally found a sport I liked... Something that almost made me forget about...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And three... Two... One... Go!
Sam dives into the pool...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Fast?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: How `fast` can you do the 50M backstroke? Or the 50M freestyle?
nodes.text_bbcode: How [color=#e23b3b][i]fast[/i][/color] can you do the 50M backstroke? Or the 50M freestyle?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I haven't really timed myself...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'd be surprised if you could swim freestyle under 30 seconds..

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Isn't 30 seconds pretty fast?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: For a turtle maybe.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lucky for you, it sounds like you have ambition.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Get in the water. There's an empty lane on the side there. Swim to the far end and back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I can't see how `fast` you really are until we start timing it, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't see how [color=#e23b3b][i]fast[/i][/color] you really are until we start timing it, right?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Disciplined, huh? You'd be willing to go through what my athletes go through to win?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Adherence to a regimented diet, a strict sleeping schedule, and a brutal, daily practice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Trust me, Coach Kessler, I've been a cheerleader. There's no stricter diet, schedule, or practice than that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After being under Taylor's thumb, swimming sounds `easy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: After being under Taylor's thumb, swimming sounds [color=#3b78e2][i]easy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And do you have experience swimming?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, maybe I don't swim perfectly and maybe I don't know the fancy terms for all the different types of strokes, but I know what it'll take me to win.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Get in the water. There's an empty lane on the side there. Swim to the far end and back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Neither of us are going to know how good you really are until we see for ourselves, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Bye, Sam.
As Denni leaves, Sam slumps against the door and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As if I really needed to see `her...`
nodes.text_bbcode: As if I really needed to see [color=#3b78e2][i]her...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was Denni? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. `Great.` It seems like every time I get a break, something reminds me of `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. [color=#3b78e2][i]Great.[/i][/color] It seems like every time I get a break, something reminds me of [color=#3b78e2][i]him.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't run away forever, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can run away `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I can run away [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam runs upstairs.
The next day, after school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where are you taking me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have practice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you remember when I went off the deep end and called Taylor names? Yeah, I'm not a cheerleader anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is why we're not going to cheerleading. I've signed you up for some of the spring sports!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You looked so happy with archery... A sport seems like it would be the perfect distraction for you. Come on!
And for the rest of the afternoon, Sam tries out for various sports teams...
In soccer, Sam streaks across the field...
And tackles Megan, the goalie!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: `Oooooofff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oooooofff![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sam! That's not your job! And you're not supposed to use your hands to tackle. This is soccer, not football...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some European countries would disagree with you on that one...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Can you at least let Megan stand up? I'm worried she might've broken something.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh, I'll show you `broken.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'll show you [color=#3b78e2][i]broken.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perhaps this isn't your sport...
In basketball, Sam passes the ball so hard it knocks Kim down!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa! This isn't whack-a-mole. You're supposed to be aiming for the baskets, not the people!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Moving on...
In tennis, Sam pushes her partner Dex back, shoving him flat on his back.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Why'd you shove me down?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were coming onto me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sam, `love-love` is a thing in tennis!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, [color=#e23b3b][i]love-love[/i][/color] is a thing in tennis!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how is that not sketchy?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we'll be moving on now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So that's it for the popular sports... What do you think about trying out for dodgeball?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dodgeball's not a real sport.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about wrestling?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lacrosse?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm aggressive, but not `that` aggressive.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm aggressive, but not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] aggressive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Track?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Meh. Maybe later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There is one last sport... But if you're tired of trying out for teams, I understand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can do one more. What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll see... Grab a swimsuit and a towel.
The girls walk into a residential neighborhood. $ZOE turns up a driveway and heads up to a gate.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was hoping that when you told me to grab a swimsuit, you were secretly taking me to the beach.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But now I'm confused. Where are we going? Is this legal?
$ZOE opens the gate and leads Sam into a backyard with a pool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the swim team.
Sam looks over and sees a couple girls swimming the length of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The swim team is kind of new, so there aren't many girls. And Centerscore's pool is under construction, so they practice in someone's backyard for now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I figured this would be perfect. No balls to throw at people's heads, and you're basically competing against yourself.
At that moment, the swim team's coach, Coach Kessler, approaches Sam and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hey, you two! What are you doing? I can't have you distracting my athletes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry. I was just showing my cousin what your team was all about.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: We're about swimming. And this isn't a show and tell. I suggest you come back when no one's here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, don't chew my cousin out. I was coming here to see whether or not I wanted to join your crummy team.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: These girls here have worked hard to become the best. Unless you can show me something worthwhile, you can't say they're 'crummy'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can show you 'worthwhile'.
Sam sheds her jacket and clothes until she's down to her bathing suit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... You're going to try out?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: She can't. Try-outs are over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm telling you if you don't take me on your team, you're losing your best bet.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And why are `you` my best bet?
nodes.text_bbcode: And why are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] my best bet?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I'm...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll take those.
Sam takes the tray and inspects the cookies.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I suppose I'll take your apology. You seem guilty enough.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I am! I feel terrible about everything that happened! You don't deserve any of this, and I feel absolutely...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awful. I'm sure. I'm glad at least one of us feels better.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I wouldn't say 'better', but it is a big load off my chest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... Thanks for the cookies.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll take the cookies. But forget the apology. I don't want it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not like an apology's going to get my ex-boyfriend back or make everything feel right again.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it's not. I was hoping... Well, I guess that's fair.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I came over to help you feel better, and just I've made everything worse.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry, I don't think you could do `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, I don't think you could do [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam snatches the tray of cookies from Denni.
Sam lets the arrow fly.
It whizzes through the air, glancing off Sam's target and soaring towards a group of girls...
A couple lanes down, the Monarch Prep girls are enjoying their third-period elective.
Madisenn stands with an apple on her head.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Most people say that to achieve good balance, you should balance a book on your head.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Well, I say an apple is much better!
At that moment, the arrow strikes, splitting the apple in half!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Eeep!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Whoa! Watch it!
The girls dive out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: `Ahhhhh!` I'm dying! I'm dying! I'm dead! I'm dying!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhh![/i][/color] I'm dying! I'm dying! I'm dead! I'm dying!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, you're fine...
Back in Sam's lane...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoops.
Sam puts the bow down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's no use. I can't `not` think about them!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's no use. I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] think about them!

nodes.text: Sam throws the bow and arrows down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's get you home.
After Howard drops $ZOE and Sam off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry. I feel bad taking you to the archery range in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it would help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's okay. Almost impaling someone did manage to distract me from my life for about a minute.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wish I could forget all about...
Suddenly, the doorbell rings!
Sam answers the door to find Denni on the doorstep.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, there you are. In your house.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm here to apologize.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been hearing that phrase a lot lately.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I am really sorry. I don't even know how it happened with Colt, and I just feel so awful about it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This won't make it better, but I'm hoping it won't make it worse.
Denni produces a tray of neatly wrapped cookies tied with ribbons and hands them to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are those?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Snickerdoodles from that bakery down the street.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kim's bakery?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Kim's boyfriend said they were the finest items on the menu, 'delicious enough to satisfy any palette, rich and poor alike'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: High praise.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... Will you take them with my apologies?

options.label: Take the cookies and the apology.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You and Aunt Cathy are the only family I have right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're like a sister to me, and we're finally getting along, and you can't leave now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everything feels... Heavy. Between Taylor making snide remarks, and Colt breaking my heart... And I don't even have cheerleading anymore to stop thinking about it..

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just so tired of keeping it all in, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just promise me you'll try to control yourself? I'll help you forget all about Colt and Taylor and all that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll do more things together, I'll get you new friends, and we'll... We'll put you in an entirely different sport! Okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I promise.
That weekend, $ZOE and Howard drag Sam to William Tell's Archery and Apple Emporium...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are we in the middle of nowhere?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We thought you should try archery.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Archery? We drove an hour and a half for this? This is your brilliant solution, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't blame her. It was actually my idea.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard? This was your dumb idea?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're not allowed to be grumpy until you've tried it.
After renting their equipment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So just notch the arrow in the bow... And use your three fingers to pull the string back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bring your fingers to the corner of your mouth... And let loose!
Twang! $ZOE's arrow flies into the target.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know how to shoot an arrow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I used to go once or twice a year with my parents...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...When they were here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's right, I'm $ZOE's family now. I guess I should try this for her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, how do I do this again?
Sam notches her bow and looses an arrow! It flies straight over the target!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is impossible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you focusing on the target?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I can see in the target is Colt's smug `grin`... Or Taylor's `face.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All I can see in the target is Colt's smug [color=#3b78e2][i]grin[/i][/color]... Or Taylor's [color=#3b78e2][i]face.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Try clearing your mind first. That's kind of the point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, sometimes if you have something else to focus on, it helps separate your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Clear your mind...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean you have nothing left?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you don't have Colt anymore... But you still have me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... Or did you not even think of that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw, $ZOE, don't cry. Come on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt and Denni and Taylor... I'm going to have to see them all the time if I stay here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt broke my heart, $ZOE, and I can't forgive him. And I just don't know if I can keep coming to school and running into him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least not without punching a locker or two...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam...
$ZOE hugs Sam tightly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't get yourself expelled. It wouldn't be fair. I'd be so upset if you left! We've just become friends!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Wait up!
$ZOE runs up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE, if you're going to try to talk me into going back and apologizing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you kidding? The only way Taylor would let you onto that team would be if you begged her to take you back in front of the entire school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to know what you think you're doing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're alienating everyone, you're destroying school property, and I think you made Amanda cry because of your cruelty to animals...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did someone explain the Lyle the Lizard mascot head isn't real?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know how Amanda can't tell the difference between fantasy and reality!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you keep acting this way, things are going to escalate to the point where you're going to get yourself kicked out of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you care enough about that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There is no point staying here!

options.label: I've got nothing left at Centerscore.
I'm just so upset about Colt.

nodes.text: Great, but not quite `perfect.` Try again to unlock the bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, but not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Try again to unlock the bonus scene!

nodes.text: And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!
Slice through

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll prove to Coach Kessler that I can be on his dumb swim team...
Sam thrashes through the water messily, trying to work her way through the water until...
Sam hits her head on the wall on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Owwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Owwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam climbs out of the water, and $ZOE runs to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Looks like it's just a bump. She'll be fine. The only thing she needs is to get out of my pool, so I can continue to train the real swimmers here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll get out of your way.
Coach Kessler turns back to the swimming pool as Sam begins to collect her things.
And `belly-flops!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [b]belly-flops![/b]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Owwwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Owwwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Slowly and painfully, Sam doggie paddles back to the pool's edge and climbs out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay? That looked like it hurt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you need to see a doctor?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: She'll be fine. The only thing she needs is to get out of my pool, so I can continue to train the real swimmers here.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I don't appreciate people who waste my time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll get out of your way.
Coach Kessler turns back to the swimming pool as Sam begins to collect her things.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: And as Sam warms up to her new position on the swim team...
What is cheerleading going to be like without Sam?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, girls! Pyramid up!
The cheerleaders stare blankly at one another.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you all standing around for? Pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Some time before I get old, please?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We don't know where to stand, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not like I changed the positions, girls.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hector and I are still not girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Girls', 'guys', whatever. What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I used to stand next to Sam. But if she's not next to me, it looks unbalanced.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, and I can't form the pyramid without her. Sam used to hold me up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I feel sort of wrong being here without her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Keith, Maria, you raise excellent points. Hmmm, who has to be on the bottom now that Sam is gone?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who's made me angry lately?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica, what was your last offence?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We have the same hair color?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You got highlights. What about before that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wore the same black shoes as you did on black-shoe Friday?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You threw them away. Besides, that was ages ago...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maria, what about you? When was the last time I was mad at you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Last year, when I tripped on your crutches on accident...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, I made you go around with crutches to see what it felt like. Keith?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You didn't like the music mix I made for our last routine.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I had you listen to it for a week. $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you've ever been `that` mad at me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think you've ever been [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor, you haven't really been that mad at anyone since Sam ruined your date with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! You're right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The pyramid's just not as much fun if I don't get to pick on Sam!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right. Someone's got to be on the bottom... Want to draw straws?
Whoa, looks like Taylor's going to have some trouble adjusting!
And that's your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High School!
Don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what I'm doing... Why did I think being on a sports team would fix my problems?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Joining a sport wasn't going to fix anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was just going to make you relax enough so you could face your problems.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Obviously it didn't `work.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Obviously it didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]work.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you gave it your best try.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what, $ZOE? I don't think you really gave it `your` best try. Archery? Sports? That's not going to help me out.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what, $ZOE? I don't think you really gave it [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] best try. Archery? Sports? That's not going to help me out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I always give everything 110 percent! And I don't lose my temper whenever someone calls me out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm saying that `I` didn't get kicked off the `cheerleading team` because I chose the `wrong guy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm saying that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] didn't get kicked off the [color=#3b78e2][i]cheerleading team[/i][/color] because I chose the [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong guy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you did not just say that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did! Because I am so super mad at you right now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, it's no tea party from where I'm standing, goody-goody.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Tea party'? 'Goody-goody'? You sound exactly like Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Take that back!
Sam pushes $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! The entire time you've been so stubborn. You can't let go of anything.
$ZOE pushes back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I'm so stubborn, then you're a meddler! You can't leave me alone to deal with my own feelings on my own!

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: I feel so... `Weightless...`

nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awesome! I've never seen you swim before. I didn't know you could hold your breath for that long!

nodes.speaker: Jane

nodes.text: How did you manage to swim so fast?

nodes.text: I don't know... I just felt so `light.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... I just felt so [color=#3b78e2][i]light.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You have terrible form. Your hand crosses your body at the wrong angle, you drop your elbow, and you don't stop to take full breaths.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'm surprised you didn't faint on your way back.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In all my years as a girls' swimming coach, I've never seen someone more awkward in the water...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh. I see. I'll leave then. Come on, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And where do you think you're going? I didn't dismiss you yet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought my trial run was over.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: So you blunder through the water...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But you're fast.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And if you can go that fast with that form, you're probably worth working on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It means I'll see you tomorrow at four sharp.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See you then...
